name: @blush-dev/framework
description: Build tooling for the Blush admin app (resources/admin, built into public/admin) and core's site assets (resources/site, built into public/site).

scripts.admin:build: npm run admin:check && vite build --config resources/admin/vite.config.ts
scripts.site:build: npm run site:check && vite build --config resources/site/vite.config.ts
